description:
amterp, 2026-09-28: "council: encourage agents to organically coordinate if they're working on the same cwd or whatever." Then: "let's talk more about this another time; if implemented poorly it could get anything and subvert the user's intention."

Not ready to build. The open question is how agents discover a neighbor (same directory, same repo, same worktree) and what they may do about it without a person's say, so that coordination never overrides what the person asked each agent to do.
title: 🤝 Agents in one directory find each other and coordinate
